text: For a long time, our windows have been buried. Stacked. Overlapping. Lost behind each other.
We dragged. We resized. We pressed Alt Tab, again, and again. Enough.
Introducing Mosaico. A tiling window manager for Windows, written in Rust.
say: Introducing Moh-SIGH-koh. A tiling window manager for Windows, written in Rust.

text: Every window gets its own tile. Side by side. Nothing on top of anything else.
Three layouts. Change your mind with a single key.
Eight workspaces, on every monitor. Your keyboard is back in charge.
Monocle mode when you need to focus. The border turns green, so you always know.
Support for multiple themes. The status bar and the borders follow.
Prefer clicking? The settings window changes everything. No config files required.
And when you want more, script it. Lua scripts react to your desktop, and act on it.
Free. Open source. One line to install.
Mosaico. Every window in its place.
say: Moh-SIGH-koh. Every window in its place.
